ingredients: 600 g (1.3 lb) Maris Piper potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
1 large leek, trimmed, halved and sliced
1½ cups (125 g/4.4 oz) grated Cheddar cheese
¼ cup (20 g) parsley leaves, chopped
steps: Boil the potatoes in a medium pot filled with water for 15–20 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, heat 3 teaspoons oil in a lidded frying pan over a low-medium heat.
In the frying pan, cook the leeks for 10 minutes, covering with the lid, until softened.
Drain the potatoes and leave for 5 minutes to steam-dry.
Transfer the potatoes to a large bowl and mash them with leeks, cheese, butter and most of the parsley.
Set aside for 5 minutes to allow the butter and cheese to melt. Stir briefly to combine. For a creamier mash, stir in the milk.

ingredients: 280 g (9.9 oz/2¼ sticks) unsalted butter, plus extra for greasing
steps: Preheat the oven to 190 C. Grease and line a 20 cm square cake tin.
Beat the butter and sugar in a mixing bowl, until soft and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs, one at a time, then lemon juice and zest.
Fold the flour and baking powder into the mixture.
Spoon the mixture into the cake tin.
Bake for 25 minutes until a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
Transfer the cake to a wire rack and leave it to cool.
Mix the icing sugar and lemon juice in a bowl until it is thick enough to coat the back of spoon.
Drizzle the icing over the cake.
